sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Assipattle is a Scottish hero. He appears in many folktales. The character resembles the Irish Amadán. Unlike Cinderella, Assipattle was born poor and expected to stay poor. He was lazy and unambitious. A crisis finally stirred him to action, often a threatening dragon. Once stirred, Assipattle performed heroically.
objective: Establish Assipattle as the Scottish hero who resembles the Irish Amadán.
